security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Fast local search for files, content, documents and images.
bundle.longDescription: Mnemo indexes filenames, file contents, PDFs, Office documents and OCR'd images into one local index. It is a desktop app and a read-only search backend for AI agents (MCP + CLI). No cloud, no telemetry.
